apps.name: LINKING
apps.about: A two-player strategy board game of diagonal lines, clashes and breakthroughs. Play the computer, a friend on one phone, or a friend's phone nearby over Bluetooth.

apps.name: ContactSync
apps.about: Pick tags that describe you. ContactSync matches you with people who share them and adds you to each other's phone contacts, always both ways. Your address book never leaves your phone. 18+.

apps.name: Bitnook
apps.about: A shelf of tiny web games that live on your phone, and a way to hand one to a friend. No account, no server, no feed — a game is a single HTML file that runs sealed off, with no network of its own. Pass one the way you'd pass a photo.
